Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: A project automation inquiry submitted by an authenticated user via the portfolio contact section.

authorUid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user who submitted the inquiry.

name.description: Full name of the person submitting the inquiry.

email.description: Verified contact email address of the sender.

projectType.description: Selected AI automation service or project category.

message.description: Detailed description of the automation workflow or project scope.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was last updated.

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Stores client project inquiries with PII isolation restricted to the inquiry author and verified administrators.
